in_marathi.name: Jayalatha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayalatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya: victory, Latha: prosperity. The name Jayalatha is derived from the Sanskrit language and represents the joy and success that comes with victory and prosperity.
